content.json:
## Where to Bird Today
Traffic, errors, scheduled jobs and platform events. Health and readiness probes are left out of the traffic panels. The server logs no addresses and no query strings, so usage is counted in requests, not visitors.

content.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where ContainerAppName_s == 'wtbt-server' | where Log_s startswith '{' | extend j = parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(j.msg) == 'http request' | extend path = tostring(j.path), status = toint(j.status), ms = todouble(j.duration) / 1000000.0 | where path !in ('/health', '/ready') | summarize requests = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), class = strcat(tostring(status / 100), 'xx') | order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Requests by status class

content.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where ContainerAppName_s == 'wtbt-server' | where Log_s startswith '{' | extend j = parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(j.msg) == 'http request' | extend path = tostring(j.path), status = toint(j.status), ms = todouble(j.duration) / 1000000.0 | where path !in ('/health', '/ready') | summarize requests = count(), errors = countif(status >= 500), p50_ms = round(percentile(ms, 50), 0), p95_ms = round(percentile(ms, 95), 0), max_ms = round(max(ms), 0) by path = iff(path startswith '/hotspots/', '/hotspots/{id}/species/{id}', iff(path startswith '/assets' or path startswith '/_app' or path contains '.', 'static files', path)) | order by requests desc
content.title: Endpoints: volume and latency

content.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where ContainerAppName_s == 'wtbt-server' | where Log_s startswith '{' | extend j = parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(j.msg) == 'http request' | extend path = tostring(j.path), status = toint(j.status), ms = todouble(j.duration) / 1000000.0 | where path !in ('/health', '/ready') | where path in ('/species', '/recommendations', '/recommendations/weeks', '/in-season') | summarize p95_ms = percentile(ms, 95) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), path | order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Slowest endpoints, 95th percentile (ms)

content.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where ContainerAppName_s == 'wtbt-server' | where Log_s startswith '{' | extend j = parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(j.msg) == 'http request' | extend path = tostring(j.path), status = toint(j.status), ms = todouble(j.duration) / 1000000.0 | where path !in ('/health', '/ready') | where status in (429, 403) | summarize requests = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), reason = iff(status == 429, 'rate limited', 'bot blocked') | order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Rate-limited (429) and bot-blocked (403) requests

content.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where ContainerAppName_s == 'wtbt-server' | where Log_s startswith '{' | extend j = parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(j.level) in ('ERROR', 'WARN') | project TimeGenerated, level = tostring(j.level), message = tostring(j.msg), error = tostring(j.error) | order by TimeGenerated desc | take 100
content.title: Server errors and warnings

content.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where isnotempty(ContainerJobName_s) | summarize last_run = max(TimeGenerated), lines = count(), failures = countif(Log_s contains 'ERROR' or Log_s contains 'failed') by job = ContainerJobName_s | order by job asc
content.title: Last log line of each job

content.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where isnotempty(ContainerJobName_s) | project TimeGenerated, job = ContainerJobName_s, line = Log_s | order by TimeGenerated desc | take 200
content.title: Job log lines

content.query: ContainerAppSystemLogs_CL | where isnotempty(ContainerAppName_s) | where Reason_s in ('ContainerStarted', 'ContainerTerminated') | summarize events = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), app = ContainerAppName_s, event = Reason_s | order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Server and OSRM starts and stops (scale from zero)

content.query: ContainerAppSystemLogs_CL | where Type_s == 'Warning' | where Reason_s != 'ContainerTerminated' | project TimeGenerated, app = coalesce(ContainerAppName_s, JobName_s), Reason_s, Log_s | order by TimeGenerated desc | take 100
content.title: Platform warnings

content.query: Usage | where IsBillable == true | summarize megabytes = round(sum(Quantity), 2) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), DataType | order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Log volume against the 100 MB daily cap (MB)
